comment: Interoperability, governance, law, and policy are described as “cross-cutting enablers” that should not be mistaken for infrastructure. Some of these enablers nevertheless require concrete technical services, such as audit, consent, trust, certificate, policy-management, and terminology services.

public.text: Interoperability, governance, law, and policy are described as “cross-cutting enablers” that should not be mistaken for infrastructure. Some of these enablers nevertheless require concrete technical services, such as audit, consent, trust, certificate, policy-management, and terminology services.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish cross-cutting capabilities and policies from the technical services that implement or enforce them. Clarify which services are represented as components, which are provided by foundational DPI, and which remain implementation choices.
